name: ironwood
lore_descriptor: dark and heavy as iron, dulls the woodcutter's axe
first_pickup_chronicle: Ironwood. Heavier than oak should be, harder than yew should be. Doesn't burn. Doesn't rot. The dungeon grows it where it shouldn't.
design_notes: F38 peak — wood equivalent of hardened_gold. damage_mult 1.15 (denser than steel), but weight_mult 1.2 (heavy). Fire-resistant (the only wood that is). Bridges low-tier wood to high-tier dragon/silver woods.
